newsitem.title: USA: Host Funding names executives, buys hotel.
newsitem.headline: Host Funding names executives, buys hotel.

text.p: Host Funding Inc said on Wednesday that it has named William Birdsall chairman of the board and Bona Allen as chief financial officer.
The appointments were made on March 13, 1997, it said.

Birdsall was former president and chief executive officer of Price REIT Inc. Allen has worked in the real estate industry since 1983 and has worked with president Michael S. McNulty in other engagements since 1992, the company said.
The management additions were the result of Host becoming a self administered real estate investment trust in February 1997, Host Funding said.
Also, the company said it acquired the 90-room Super "8" in Flagstaff, Ariz., from a Midwest pension fund. A unit of Interstate Hotel Corp will continue to lease the property, Host Funding said.
The property was financed from a revised credit line provided by Credit Suisse First Boston, Host Funding said.
The existing $15.5 million credit line was increased to $21,725,000 with $13 million placed on a long-term fixed-rate basis and the balance maturing in 24 months, Host said.
After the acquisition of the Flagstaff property, Host Funding will own 10 properties with 767 rooms in seven states.
